t: This is the Islington Green War Memorial, which stands at Islington Green in the London Borough of Islington. It's a memorial to those from the area lost in war. The sculptor was John Maine, born in 1942, who made the work. I don't have more detail about the figures or the inscriptions, so take a moment to read what's written on it and see what names and dates it records. Memorials like this one often hold the most meaning in the details close up.
